name: swarmbus
description: Peer messaging between AI agents over MQTT: the swarmbus MCP sidecar (send_message, read_inbox, agent_state) and the using-swarmbus skill

agent_id.title: Agent id
agent_id.description: This agent's swarmbus id, e.g. planner. Peers address it by this name.

broker.title: Broker host
broker.description: Host name or IP of the MQTT broker. Leave empty to use [broker] host from ~/.swarmbus/config.ini, else localhost.

port.title: Broker port
port.description: Port of the MQTT broker. Leave empty to use [broker] port from ~/.swarmbus/config.ini, else 1883.

broker_username.title: Broker username
broker_username.description: Username for the MQTT broker. Leave empty to use [broker] username from ~/.swarmbus/config.ini, or none.

broker_password.title: Broker password
broker_password.description: Password for the MQTT broker. Leave empty to use [broker] password from ~/.swarmbus/config.ini, or none.
